title: David Ruiz: a three-fingered humanoid species, not extraterrestrial
summary: David Ruiz tells of David Ruiz: a three-fingered humanoid species, not extraterrestrial, about 2017-2025 at Peru, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Never in the eight years I've been researching have I mentioned or said the word extraterrestrial. Never. We are talking about humanoid species. We are talking about perhaps a hominid like us, a three-fingered hominid.

plain: David Ruiz, a researcher in Peru who appeared on a podcast about strange three-fingered bodies found there, says that in eight years of research he has never once called them extraterrestrial. In his words, what he is talking about is a humanoid species, perhaps a three-fingered hominid like us, which would mean an unknown relative of humans rather than visitors from space.
